text: Parking availability around Shirley Street Junior Public School has been a major problem for residents living on and around Shirley Street and St. Clarens Avenue. Over the past several months, I have worked closely with residents, City staff, and the Toronto District School Board to develop a comprehensive parking plan. This collaborative approach has focused on striking a balance between parking regulations that better reflect the needs of the local community and those that continue to support school operations. A review by Transportation Services determined that many parking rules in the area are inconsistent and that revised parking amendments could be implemented without affecting the existing school bus loading zone.
